text: …すごいわね　つよいの　みつけたら　おしえて！

structure.jp: つよいの　みつけたら
structure.en: if you find a strong one

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when that happens'. みつけたら = 'if you find one'.

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の after a describing word stands for a thing already understood, like 'one' in English; here it means a Pokémon. つよいの = 'a strong one'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て on its own is a casual request, short for てください. おしえて = 'tell me'.
